external_collaboration.evidence_quote: With our large assortment of yachts, motorboats & rigid inflatables, we have the complete flexibility to run courses for private individuals, companies and organisations alike. We offer training for all, from an absolute beginner to aspiring Yachtmaster Ocean Skippers. We also work alongside and are the training provider for Solent Boat Charters, a large local sailing events company. We have 6 classrooms, including a training workshop, all within the marina. Together with free accommodation, inc

internal_collaboration.evidence_quote: Our Fleet of Boats are based in Southampton, allowing us to offer courses & events all over the Solent.
